PHYSICS — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Refraction of light ● Verification of laws of refraction of light. ● Determinati.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetic effect of electric current ● Magnetization and demagnetization . ● Magn.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fluid Flow ● Types of fluid flow (steady flow, unsteady flow, laminar flow, turb.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Capacitors ● Electric field patterns. ● Force between charges. ● Capacitors and ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Capacitors ● Electric field patterns. ● Force between charges. ● Capacitors and .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Capacitors ● Electric field patterns. ● Force between charges. ● Capacitors and .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Capacitors ● Electric field patterns. ● Force between charges. ● Capacitors and .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Capacitors ● Electric field patterns. ● Force between charges. ● Capacitors and .

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat Transmission ● Heat. ● Modes of heat transmission . ● Applications of heat .

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Capacitors 3.2 Magnetic effect of electric current 3.3 Diodes 4.0 Environmental .

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac? (1 mark)

   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Projectile Motion ● Free fall. ● Projectile motion ● . ● Trajectory motion. ● Ac.
